name: inventory-poc
description: Local-only MERN inventory management PoC (server + client)

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix client install
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n server,client -c blue,magenta "npm --prefix server run dev" "npm --prefix client run dev"
scripts.test: npm --prefix server test && npm run test:runner
